svg.title: dma_hello — Out-of-Band Windows 11 PE32+ Injection via FPGA DMA
svg.desc: Research poster in five sections: intent and hardware boundary, nine-stage pipeline, kernel structure anatomy, defensive notes and bugcheck writes, and source citations 1 through 24.
svg.text: SYSTEMS SECURITY RESEARCH EXHIBIT · HARDWARE-ASSISTED WINDOWS KERNEL & MEMORY INTERNALS
dma_hello — Out-of-Band Windows 11 PE32+ Injection via FPGA DMA
PFN unlink, one adjacent VAD EndingVpn, page tables, and a per-CR3 page copy. Payload then calls user32.[1][2][20]
Live-verified: Windows 11 25H2 (Germanium 40-bit PFN)[6] | Transport: MemProcFS (vmm.dll + leechcore.dll) over fpga://[4][24] | C++20 (src/dma_hello/)[24]
VERIFIED EXHIBIT METRICS (PROVABLE IN SOURCE)

Commit writes:
only the PDB fields that resolve[13]

svg.text: I. RESEARCH INTENT, KERNEL CONSISTENCY THESIS & HARDWARE BOUNDARY TOPOLOGY
1. Research Intent & Core Thesis: Why Out-of-Band Kernel Synthesis Matters
• Research Objective (DMA mapping, then one user32 call):[1][2][20]
An external PCIe/FPGA DMA device writes free frames, one VAD end, page tables, and a copied code page, maps a PE32+, and
resolves the IAT. src/ calls no allocation or thread API. LaunchHello then calls MessageBoxA or MessageBeep.
• Why Naive DMA Writes Crash Windows (The Kernel Consistency Gap):[8][11][14][17]
Stomping free physical frames or inserting raw PTEs violates Windows Memory Manager invariants, causing fatal bugchecks on trim or exit:
PFN_LIST_CORRUPT (0x4E/0x99) · IRQL_NOT_LESS_OR_EQUAL (0xA @ VA 0x18) · QUOTA_UNDERFLOW (0x21) · Shared DLL Hang
• PDB-Driven Kernel Structure Synthesis:[4][7][8][12][13]
Dynamically loads the target kernel PDB (ntoskrnl.exe / ntkrnlmp.exe) via VMMDLL_Pdb* to resolve live
symbols and struct field offsets (MmPfnDatabase, MiSystemPartition, MiState,
_MMPFN, _MMVAD_SHORT, _EPROCESS). Missing fields are skipped.
Fail-Closed Writes (Two Logged Structure Fallbacks):[2][3][7][9][10][12][17]
Empty PTEs before the claim, ListName checks, full reads, 8x 1ms PFN verify. GetTickCount[64] throws. Color Total is exact and never raised.
_MMPFN falls back to 0x30; VAD Vpn to 25H2 +0x18..+0x21 (logged). A color-cap miss logs ERROR and keeps the splice. Exit 1, bad args 2.
2. System Actors & Out-of-Band Hardware Boundary Topology

svg.text: II. END-TO-END 9-STAGE INJECTION PIPELINE — VERIFIED CALL ORDER IN inject.cpp::run() & mm/allocate.cpp::allocate()[2][10]

g.text: Parse PE32+ Payload & Open MemProcFS Session[2][4][5][15]
1. PeImage::load(dll_path) validates MZ, PE\0\0, AMD64 (0x8664), and PE32+
(0x20B); rejects TLS callbacks (tls_size != 0); parses sections/relocs/IAT.[15]
2. Sizes region: need = max(alloc_size, align4K(size_of_image + 0x2000))
(default alloc_size = 0x100000, protection 0x40 PAGE_EXECUTE_READWRITE).[2][3]
3. Session(device) checks dbghelp/symsrv.dll and opens VMMDLL_Initialize
with -device fpga:// -waitinitialize -disable-python -printf.[4]
4. find_process() resolves pid, vaEPROCESS, and cr3 = paDTB; lazy-loads
ntoskrnl.exe / ntkrnlmp.exe PDB via VMMDLL_PdbLoad on symbol queries.[4][5]
inject.cpp:18-38 · pe.cpp:188-268 · session.cpp:29-69, 111-196
Scan VAD Holes & Pre-Verify Empty Leaf PTEs[10][11][12]
1. mem.vad_map(pid) (VMMDLL_Map_GetVadU) fetches active virtual ranges.[5][10]
2. vad_candidates() scans [0x10000, 0x7FFFFFF00000), preferring holes
right after an existing VAD; blocks null page, 0x7FF00000–0x80000000, and
>= 0x7FFFFFF00000 (never touches KUSER_SHARED_DATA's page).[12]
3. range_block() walks CR3 (skipping unmapped 512G/1G/2M spans) and requires
RangeBlock::Clear (every leaf PTE == 0; rejects Large/Present/Software).[10][11]
4. plan_candidate() walks EPROCESS.VadRoot (depth <= 64) to confirm a
predecessor _MMVAD_SHORT node exists before claiming any physical PFN.[10][12]
allocate.cpp:31-64 · vad.cpp:20-27,397-458 · page_tables.cpp:243-279
Claim Physical Frames & Unlink MMPFN Free Lists[6][7][8][9]
1. Deref nt!MmPfnDatabase. phys_map (pfn >= 0x100) is typed by GetPfnEx
in batches of 128. Claim batches of 256 stop at pages+32 or 32768 seen.[5][6][7]
2. Heads: Mm/Mi*PageListHead or PageLists (zeroed +0, free +0x80
if that child field is missing, ListName checked). No MiState: interior unlink.[7][8]
3. Color on: tails only. Exact Total drop, wait 5 ms, Blink before Flink.
One page: both head links = end. Else predecessor Flink = end. Page links stay.[6][8]
4. Aggregate Total is best-effort (settle within 8). A miss does not undo the
splice or raise Total. Then e1=0x46, share 1, and only then u1 = 0.[8][9]
Grow Existing _MMVAD_SHORT Node Over the Hole[10][12]
1. Does not insert a VAD node, rebalance the AVL tree, or read VadType.
The adjacent node keeps its previous type. A hole with no neighbor is refused.[12]
2. Resolves _MMVAD_SHORT offsets via PDB (StartingVpn, EndingVpn,
StartingVpnHigh, EndingVpnHigh; 25H2 fallback +0x18..+0x21).[12]
3. Computes inclusive end VPN: end_vpn = (base_va >> 12) + pages - 1.[10]
4. extend_vad_end() → expand_ending_vpn() writes low 32 bits (uint32_t) to
EndingVpn and bits 32..39 (uint8_t) to EndingVpnHigh via write_kernel().[10][12]
Install 4-Level Page Tables & Activate MMPFN Entries[6][8][11]
1. map_range() walks CR3 (PML4 → PDPT → PD → PT); missing tables pop a
frame from table_frames, zero its 4 KiB PA, and queue a PendingLink.[11]
2. pte_kernel_va reads live nt!MmPteBase and throws if it is missing or
not canonical: base + ((va & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFF) >> 9 & 0x7FFFFFFFF8).[6][11]
3. mark_pfn_active writes e1=0x46 before clearing u1. Data: share 1, ref 1.
New tables: u1=0, share used+1, used count in OriginalPte bits 16-25.[8][11]
4. Each child adds one share. Linked tables store used in u1 bits 32-41;
unlinked tables use OriginalPte. RefCount stays 1. Publish bottom-up.[6][11]
allocate.cpp:82 · page_tables.cpp:56-116, 224-235, 355 · pfn.cpp:1103-1156
Write Commit Counters The PDB Resolves[10][13]
charge_private_commit writes each counter the PDB resolves. A missing
field is skipped. None resolved: log, leave uncharged. Job commit stays.[13]
1. VAD CommitCharge (+ High): +pages when that node and field exist.[13]
2. EPROCESS.CommitCharge and peak, and NumberOfPrivatePages: +pages.[13]
3. VirtualSize/Peak +bytes only when grow_virtual is set. COW passes false.[13]
4. QuotaBlock PsPageFile[2] Usage/Peak +bytes. Stride from the PDB, else 0x20.[13]
5. MmTotalCommittedPages +pages. No WSLE. COW charges the covering VAD.[13]
allocate.cpp:85 · vad.cpp:279-395 · hook.cpp:177, 283
Map Relocated PE32+ Image & Patch Target IAT[2][15][16]
1. pe.mapped(allocation.va) copies headers (size_of_headers) and sections
(s.va) and applies kRelDir64 (10) & kRelHighLow (3) base relocations.[16]
2. write_image() writes the buffer via write_process_va() (translating each
4 KiB chunk via virt_to_phys(cr3, va)) and verifies 'MZ' readback.[11][16]
3. resolve_imports() maps API-set names (api-ms-win-crt-* → ucrtbase,
api-ms-win-core-* → kernel32/kernelbase/ntdll, vcruntime140* → ntdll)
and writes resolved export VAs (export_addr) to base + item.iat_rva.[5][16]
inject.cpp:34-36 · pe.cpp:146-186, 270-344 · page_tables.cpp:311-328
Build One-Shot Stub, Trampoline & Per-CR3 COW Page[11][17][18][19]
1. Blocks kernel32/kernelbase!GetTickCount[64] (HookError). Steals the
first instruction when it is >= 5 bytes; otherwise steals out to 14.[17][18]
2. Writes flag_va (+0x0), stub_va (+0x10), and 16B-aligned trampoline_va
(RIP-relocated stolen bytes + JMP back) in code_page (grows VAD if needed).[17][18][19]
3. stage_cow_page copies the hook page onto a spare PFN. A separate cave
page is COWed too. mark_pfn_active, then publish_cow_pte rewrites only
this CR3 (P|RW|US|A|D). Other processes keep old_pa. One-page commit.[11][17]
inject.cpp:37 · hook.cpp:113-297 · x64.cpp:314-448 · page_tables.cpp:330-346
Patch Physical COW Frame & Fire Payload on Thread[17][19][20]
1. A 5-byte insn inside ±2GB gets E9. Farther, E9 aims at an int3 cave
and FF 25 to the stub. Shorter prologues use FF 25. Foreign detours chain.[17][19]
2. Writes detour to physical RAM: mem.write(hook_pa, padded, physical=true)
at hook_pa = (cow_frame << 12) | (hook_addr & 0xFFF).[17]
3. PeekMessageW hits the E9. lock cmpxchg stores 1 in flag_va once.
The body saves rcx, rdx, r8, r9, calls DllMain(base,1,0) then
LaunchHello (MessageBoxA or MessageBeep), then jumps to the trampoline.[19][20]
hook.cpp:226-299 · x64.cpp:391-448 · hello_dll.cpp:13 · beep_dll.cpp:13

svg.text: III. KERNEL DATA STRUCTURE & MEMORY SURGERY ANATOMY (WINDOWS 11 24H2/25H2 GERMANIUM INTERNALS)

g.text: A. _MMPFN (0x30B) State Transition & Dual Free-List Splice[6][7][8][11]

Germanium (24H2/25H2) Dual Free-List Unlink Invariants (unlink_one):[6][8][9]
• Two List Terminators: Aggregate lists end with 40 ones (0xFFFFFFFFFF);
4K color lists (MiReplenishPageSlist) end with 38 ones (0x3FFFFFFFFF).[6][8]
• Per-Color Head Lookup: Walks MiState.Hardware.NumaMemoryRanges →
NodeInformation.FreePageInfo 4K slot, then pfn % PageColors[3].[8]
• Safe State Ordering: set_low_pfn preserves upper node/lock bits; unlinked
page's own u1/u2 keep neighbor links until mark_pfn_active writes e1=6
before clearing u1 (the write aimed at walker bugcheck 0xA).[8][11][14]
• Totals: aggregate settles within 8. Color Total must match the drop.[8]
B. 4-Level CR3 Page Tables, Hyperspace & Per-Process COW[6][11][17]

(level+1) times via nt!MmPteBase so every new table's PteAddress matches.[6][11]
• Bottom-Up: leaf first, then publish_pending links PT → PD → PDPT → PML4.
+1 share per child. Used: u1 32-41 if linked, else OriginalPte 16-25.[11]

C. Allocated VA Layout, One-Shot Guard Stub & Trampoline[16][17][18][19]
Extended _MMVAD_SHORT Region (allocation.va .. + allocation.size):[12][17]
allocation.va + 0x0000 .. + pe.size_of_image : Mapped PE32+ Payload[15][16]
• Headers ('MZ' readback) + sections + relocs (DIR64=10, HIGHLOW=3)[16]
• IAT: MessageBoxA (--hello) or MessageBeep (--beep) · Export LaunchHello[16][20]
code_page = allocation.va + size - 0x1000 (or grown +0x1000 past PE)[17]
• flag_va (code_page + 0x00): 8B flag; lock cmpxchg stores 1 only while it is 0[17][19]
• stub_va (code_page + 0x10): build_oneshot_stub() x64 machine code:[19]
51 52 31 C0 48 BA <flag> ; push rcx,rdx; xor eax,eax; mov rdx, flag
B1 01 F0 0F B0 0A 5A 59 ; mov cl,1; lock cmpxchg [rdx],cl; pop rdx,rcx
0F 85 <rel32> ; jne trampoline when the flag was already 1
51 52 41 50 41 51 ; push rcx, rdx, r8, r9
48 83 EC 28 ... FF D0 ; sub rsp,0x28; DllMain(base,1,0); call export
48 83 C4 28 41 59 41 58 5A 59 ; add rsp; pop r9, r8, rdx, rcx
FF 25 00 00 00 00 <tramp> ; jmp [rip] to trampoline (jne lands on a copy)
trampoline_va = align16(stub_va + stub.size() + 16)[17][18]
• relocate_stolen() decodes stolen instructions (decode_insn) and fixes RIP
ModRM (mod=0, rm=5) disp32 (new_disp = target - new_rip) & rel8/rel32.[18]
• Appends encode_jump(tramp_end, hook_addr + stolen.size()) (E9 or FF 25).[17][19]

svg.text: IV. SECURITY IMPLICATIONS, DEFENSIVE COUNTERMEASURES, BUGCHECK ENGINEERING & VERIFICATION
SUMMARY PANEL — SECURITY IMPLICATIONS, TELEMETRY EVASION & DEFENSIVE COUNTERMEASURES

g.text: 1. APIs The Mapper Does Not Call
• No alloc, map, or thread API in src/:[1][2]
VirtualAllocEx, WriteProcessMemory, NtMapViewOfSection,
LoadLibrary, and CreateRemoteThread do not appear in src/.
LaunchHello still calls user32.[1][20]
• Notify paths the mapper does not enter:[1][4][5]
Load-image notify, thread-creation notify, and ETW Ti
alloc/protect watch those APIs. The mapper does not call
them. MessageBoxA and MessageBeep still run on the existing
PeekMessageW thread after the hook fires.
• Threadless Execution Hijack:[3][17][19]
No new thread or APC is queued. Execution rides the
target's existing UI thread calling user32!PeekMessageW,
guarded by an 8-byte one-shot flag (flag_va) so the payload
runs once. The stub restores rcx, rdx, r8, and r9.[19]
2. Fields Written, Fields Left Alone
• MMPFN fields this path fills:[8][11]
A mapped page is ActiveAndValid (6) with hyperspace
PteAddress and demand-zero OriginalPte (used<<16 on new
tables). Slack stays Active, share 1, u1 0, and keeps its
old PteAddress. COW keeps old share.
• VAD end and commit writes:[12][13]
EndingVpn grows. VadType stays, so an image VAD stays an
image VAD. Commit fields update only when the PDB has them.
Table RefCount stays 1 (the 0x21 write). No WSLE.[13][14]
• Blast-Radius Isolation via COW:[11][17]
stage_cow_page() clones the hooked page into a private
frame and edits only target.cr3's leaf PTE. System-wide
callers of user32.dll never execute the patch, preventing
cross-process faults when the payload is in one VA space.
3. Defensive Mitigations & Detection
• Hardware & Hypervisor Prevention:
1. IOMMU / Kernel DMA Protection (VT-d / AMD-Vi) blocks unauthorized
PCIe devices from reading/writing kernel & process physical RAM.
2. HVCI / VBS (SLAT / EPT): Hypervisor enforces code integrity in
Second-Level Paging; guest HVCI can refuse a guest RWX leaf.
• Forensic & Anti-Cheat Detection Vectors:
1. VAD / PTE Audit: Flag _MMVAD_SHORT nodes grown past their backing
section or private VAD spans with NX=0 (0x40) leaf PTEs.[3][11][12]
2. Shared DLL COW Scan: Compare user32.dll leaf PTEs in CR3 against
the shared prototype PTE; detect private RW=1, D=1 code pages
starting with a 5B E9, or FF 25 in a cave.[11][17]
3. Unlinked PE Scan: write_image() leaves 'MZ'/'PE' at allocation.va
absent from the process PEB_LDR_DATA module lists.[16]
BUGCHECK WRITES IN SOURCE & HARDWARE-FREE TESTS[14][21][22][23]
1. Writes aimed at these bugchecks. No dump is in the tree:[8][11][13][14][17]
Failure / Bugcheck
Cause named in comments
Write this tree performs
PFN_LIST_CORRUPT[14]
Table share hit 0 with present leaves, or a stale Total was raised
+1 share/child; Modified clear; color Total is never raised[8][11][14]
IRQL_NOT_LESS[14]
Free page with u1=0, or color Total above the reachable Blink chain
Cap Total to that chain; e1=0x46 before u1 is cleared[8][11][14]
QUOTA_UNDERFLOW[14]
Exit returns more pagefile quota than charged if table RefCount > 1
Keep table RefCount=1; charge PsPageFile[2] quota bytes[11][13][14]
Global OS Hang
Shared DLL Patch[17]
Patching shared GetTickCount[64] or shared user32 page without COW
Throw HookError on GetTickCount; spare PFN required to COW[17]
2. SimulatedMemory, 122 Catch2 Cases. Not a Windows boot:[21][22][23][24]
• memory.hpp: dma_hello_lib talks to Memory, not vmm.dll.
SimulatedMemory stores pages and accepts the writes. It is not ntoskrnl.[21]
• 122 TEST_CASE macros, 14 files. "~[system]" runs 119. One case
checks the 0x1A/0x41790 used-count split (OriginalPte vs u1).[22]
• CI (.github/workflows/tests.yml): Builds dma_hello_tests.exe on windows-2022
and runs "~[system]" -r junit::out=test-results.xml -r console.[23]
